infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: FindYoWay uses your camera for obstacle detection and reading building signs to help visually impaired users navigate safely.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: FindYoWay needs your microphone for voice navigation commands. You can speak destinations like 'Take me to Apollo Hospital'.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: FindYoWay uses your location to provide turn-by-turn navigation guidance both outdoors and indoors.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: FindYoWay tracks location to detect when you enter or leave buildings and switch navigation modes automatically.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: FindYoWay uses speech recognition to understand your voice commands for hands-free navigation.

plugins.microphonePermission: Allow FindYoWay to access your microphone for voice commands.
